description: B13 reworks coastline geometry with seeded correlated deformation and uneven embayments. NE broadly two large land sections with remnants, SE distributed complex fragments. No precise B11 outline required; no sea names or borders assigned.
design_changes: fracture former southwest microcontinent into two disconnected terrestrial pieces with 28-unit diagonal seaway
add seven nonuniform small candidate rift islets without coastline intersections
do not move core supercontinent or other established relative geography
restore equal-area comparison for map-level proportion review
approved_relationships_preserved_in_cano: 联合城和人民天国同超级大陆
北冠半岛、抵抗者之弧三处山口

canon_scope: Only preexisting relative geographic relations are canon. All global continent polygons and hypothetical latitude coverage remain optional.
parent_generation: B08 geometry and shelf-grid data preserved from Git history

rift_reconstruction.design_goal: Introduce varied scales of enclosed/semi-enclosed basins, island passages and distant oceans, not 1 continent per official sea name

b07_review.landscape_approach: Blind staggered coves from opposing shores do not cross entire central continental blocks; random fragments constrained near NE/SE coastal and fault water and checked for overlap.
b07_review.visual_density_policy: Nine asymmetric clusters are retained, with a mixture of larger and micro fragments. Extra point-like islands removed.

water_surface_connectivity.caveat: Raster water connectivity only; no navigable depth or actual ocean topology claim.

geo_source_notes: NOAA bathymetry and ocean-floor features explain how continental shelf, slope, deep basin and trench are distinct morphological structures.
